correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, cyclic binary domination on C_n squared is precisely a 5-zero forbidden pattern. The transfer matrix closed walks biject to these words, the exact two-point trace identity is derived, and affine support yields strict covariance positivity. The Perron root is the inverse root t of sum(t^j,j=1..5)=1; its reset renewal chain gives the exact infinite-volume gap law. Exponential Perron mixing proves uniform convergence in Fourier index. The rational P/Q identity and degree-six R identity were verified exactly as polynomial remainders modulo the quintic using verify_symbolic.py. verify.py uses exact rational interval arithmetic: it isolates t, verifies three alternating derivative roots, proves at most three roots by Descartes, and rigorously orders all candidate peak heights and endpoints. The finite checker independently enumerates all allowed cyclic binary words for n=3..14 and checks exact two-point transfer counts. Finite enumeration is not used as an infinite proof; no stronger finite extremal index claim is made.

originality.rationale: The novel part compared on mathematical implication is the two-peak strict ordering and sharp limiting Fourier covariance condition ratio of uniform dominating sets on square cycles, together with the explicit finite cyclic covariance spectrum. General renewal diffraction implies the functional form of the limiting spectrum after identifying the gap law, and this is expressly credited; it does not state the nontrivial algebraic peak-count and ordering for the five-gap weights or the finite square-cycle covariance spectrum. Published domination polynomial results establish counts and unimodality, not this two-point harmonic theorem. Closest published database records concern proper colourings, independent sets or certain dense cyclic transversals, whose measures do not imply the statement. Searches do not prove global novelty; priority risk remains.
